events.text: Battle of the Plains of Abraham: British forces defeat the French at Quebec.
The Congress of the Confederation sets the date for the first U.S. presidential election.
The British bombardment of Fort McHenry begins, inspiring "The Star-Spangled Banner".
Railroad worker Phineas Gage survives an iron rod through his skull, a landmark case for brain science.
A temperature of 58 °C is recorded at Al Aziziya, Libya; it was later ruled invalid.
Nintendo releases Super Mario Bros. in Japan.
A radioactive source is taken from an abandoned clinic in Goiânia, Brazil, causing a contamination disaster.
The Oslo I Accord is signed by Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization.

births.text: Clara Schumann, German pianist and composer
